THIS WP IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO QUASH THE AWARD NOTICE DATED 12.12.2018 ISSUD UNDER SEC.12(2)
OF THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT VIDE ANNEXURE-E IN RESPECT OF 27 GUNTAS, AND DIRECT THEM TO PAY AS PER THE PROVISIONS OF THE RIGHT OF FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY ACT OR IN THE ALTERNATIVE TO PAY RS.9,10,000/- PER GUNTA OF LAND AND ETC.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
2.

In this writ petition, the petitioners are assailing the award notice dated 12.12.2018 (Annexure-E)
issued under Section 12(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short 'L.A.' Act).

3. It is contended by Sri.Rajashekhar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners that the respondent authorities while computing compensation insofar as the land acquisition is concerned ought to have considered the Joint Resolution NC: 2024:KHC:45192 passed by the respondent-authorities as per Annexure-D and also it is contended by the learned counsel appearing for petitioners that though an extent of 26 guntas as per Annexure-C has been acquired by the respondent-authorities, the award notice under Section 12(2) of L.A. Act has been issued insofar as only 23 guntas.
Accordingly, sought for interference of this Court.

4. Per contra, Sri.Ravindranath, learned AGA submitted that petitioners cannot assail the award notice issued under Section 12(2) of L.A. Act produced at Annexure-E.
5.

In view of the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, I find force in the submission made by the learned AGA that the award notice issued under Section 12(2) of the L.A. Act cannot be questioned under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.

However, taking into Smt. Mangamma vs The Principal Secretary on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147634459/
2 consideration that the land to an extent of 26 guntas in Sy.No.4/3 belonging to the petitioners has been notified as per Annexure-C, however, the award notice has been made insofar as 23 guntas is concerned.

entities.text: Smt. Mangamma vs The Principal Secretary on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: To that extent, I find force in the NC: 2024:KHC:45192 submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.

6. Accordingly, it is open for the petitioners to approach the respondent-authorities by making a representation by bringing to the notice of the respondent- authorities about the lacuna in the award notice said to have been issued on 12.12.2018.

If such application is made by the petitioners within two weeks from the of receipt of this order, the respondent-authorities shall take decision in the matter in accordance with law within outer limit of three months from the date of receipt of such representation that may be made by the petitioners in terms of the order passed by this Court.
With the above observation, writ petition is disposed of.
